common_rules: Judge actual saved224x224 crop only, without response overlays, method identity or model scores. Use the whole crop for category presence.
For each available crop consider EVERY one of75 definitions. Multiple actual objects can each be yes; multiple categories alone are not mixed/unclear.
Yes requires an identifiable actual category object or part whose identity is supported by context. A generic color/texture or an object merely suggested by context is insufficient.

Exclude drawings, photographs on paper/screens, logos, statues, miniatures and toys unless a category definition explicitly includes that object type. A tangible kite depicting a bird is kite yes and actual bird no.
Retain unclear for unidentifiable parts, ambiguous category distinctions, mixed competing evidence without a determinate identification, or inadequate detail. Unclear is not no.
Missing crop is a separate crop-level status and no75 judgments may be invented. Unreviewed available cells are unknown, never implicit no.
A reviewer may submit yes and unclear lists only after explicitly considering all75; unlisted keys become no only with all75_considered=true.
No reused broad six-concept label substitutes for a native-category judgment. Existing bear/horse labels may be compared later as reused evidence, never presented as new independent labels.

A definitely excluded alternative object is no for that category. If visible evidence leaves two or more plausible category identities unresolved, mark those plausible categories unclear; do not turn uncertainty into no or mark every absent category unclear.
Definitions are locked for this exploratory pass. Do not revise them using response outcomes, audit outcomes or method identity; proposed fixes require a separate version and disclosure.

categories.definition: An actual human, or an identifiable human body part belonging to a visible person. A human wearing an animal costume still counts as a person.
An actual pedal bicycle, including an identifiable bicycle wheel, frame or handlebar in bicycle context. Exclude motorcycles, scooters and toy/model bicycles.
An actual passenger car, including an identifiable part in car context. Exclude trucks, buses, toy/model cars and car-shaped barber/play seats.
An actual motorcycle or motor scooter, including identifiable motorcycle parts. Exclude pedal bicycles and toy/model motorcycles.
An actual airplane, including identifiable fuselage, wing, cockpit or landing gear in airplane context. Exclude birds and toy/model aircraft.
An actual bus, including identifiable bus body, windows or wheels in bus context. Exclude trains, passenger cars and model/toy buses.
An actual rail train or rail tram, including identifiable rail-vehicle parts. Exclude road buses and miniature/model trains.
An actual truck, pickup, lorry or road tanker, including identifiable truck parts. Exclude passenger cars, buses and toy/model trucks.
An actual boat or watercraft, including sailboats, kayaks and identifiable boat hulls. Exclude surfboards, toy/model boats and images of boats on screens.
An actual traffic signal assembly or identifiable signal lamp/head used to control traffic. Exclude street lamps, signs and poles without an identifiable signal.
An actual fire hydrant or identifiable hydrant body, cap or outlet. Exclude ordinary taps, pipes and ornamental/toy hydrants.
An actual traffic stop sign, including readable STOP or equivalent stop-sign text in another language and an identifiable stop-sign face/part. Exclude other traffic signs and flags alone.
An actual parking meter or identifiable meter head/body used to control paid parking. Exclude hydrants, ticket machines not identifiable as parking meters and ordinary signs.
An actual bench: a long seat intended for multiple people, including identifiable bench seat/back. Exclude individual chairs, sofas and tables.
An actual bird or identifiable bird body/head/wing/feet in bird context. Exclude bird-shaped kites, toys, statues, drawings and costumes.
An actual cat or identifiable cat body/head/part in cat context. Exclude plush cats, statues, drawings and costumes.
An actual dog or identifiable dog body/head/part in dog context. Exclude plush dogs, statues, drawings and costumes.
An actual horse or identifiable horse body/head/part. Exclude zebras, other equids whose horse identity is uncertain, toys, statues and costumes.
An actual sheep, lamb or identifiable sheep body/head/part. Exclude goats, stuffed animals, drawings and costumes.
An actual cattle animal, including cow, bull, calf or identifiable cattle part. Exclude ceramic/wooden cattle figures, toys, costumes and other ungulates.
An actual elephant or identifiable elephant body/head/trunk/part. Exclude statues, toys, drawings and costumes.
An actual bear animal or identifiable bear body/head/part. Exclude teddy bears, plush toys, humans in bear costumes and ambiguous other animals.
An actual zebra or identifiable zebra body/head/part. Exclude horses, striped objects, toys and statues.
An actual giraffe or identifiable giraffe body/head/neck/part. Exclude giraffe toys, statues and drawings.
An actual backpack/rucksack, identified by its pack body and backpack design or wearing context. Exclude handbags, suitcases and ambiguous piles of straps.
An actual umbrella or parasol, including a market/beach umbrella canopy or identifiable umbrella part. Exclude generic fabric awnings without umbrella structure.
An actual handbag, purse or carried shoulder/tote bag. Exclude backpacks, rigid luggage/suitcases and unidentified fabric bundles.
An actual necktie or bow tie, including ties worn by people or animals. Exclude scarves, bandanas/neckerchiefs, collar ribbons that are not identifiable ties and printed tie patterns.
Actual travel luggage with a suitcase/rolling-case structure, including an identifiable suitcase part. Exclude backpacks, handbags, generic boxes and ambiguous bags.
An actual flying disc/frisbee, including a disc held by a person or dog. Exclude plates, wheels and circular objects without flying-disc identity.
An actual snowboard or identifiable snowboard deck/binding in snowboarding context. Exclude skis, skateboards, surfboards and toy boards.
An actual flying kite or identifiable kite body/string assembly. Bird/animal-shaped kites count as kites, not as actual animals.
An actual baseball/softball fielding glove or mitt. Exclude batting gloves worn on a hand, ordinary gloves, boxing gloves and a baseball scene without a visible fielding glove.
An actual skateboard or identifiable skateboard deck, trucks or wheels in skateboard context. Exclude snowboards, surfboards and scooters.
An actual surfboard or identifiable surfboard deck/rail in surfing context. Exclude kayaks, boats, bodyboards whose identity is uncertain, skateboards and snowboards.
An actual tennis racket or identifiable racket head/handle in tennis context. Exclude badminton rackets when distinguishable, paddles and an empty tennis scene.
An actual bottle with an identifiable bottle body and neck/opening, including drink bottles. Exclude wide-mouth jars, cups, wine glasses and ambiguous containers.
An actual wine-glass-form drinking vessel with an identifiable bowl, stem and foot; contents need not be wine. Exclude straight beer pints/tumblers, cups/mugs and indistinct stemless vessels.

An actual drinking cup or mug, including paper/plastic cups, handled mugs and recognizable handleless drinking tumblers/pint glasses. Exclude stemmed wine-glass forms, bottles, bowls and vessels whose drinking-cup identity is unresolved.
An actual eating/serving fork identified by tines and a handle, including plastic forks. Exclude knives, spoons, garden forks and unidentified shiny lines.
An actual knife, including table/butter knives, identified by a cutting/spreading blade and handle. Exclude forks, spoons, scissors and unidentified metallic strips.
An actual eating/serving spoon identified by a bowl and handle. Exclude forks, knives, ladle-like objects if spoon identity is uncertain and unidentified shiny lines.
An actual bowl or identifiable bowl rim/body used as an open vessel. Exclude flat plates, cups/mugs, stemmed glasses and basins that are identifiable as sinks.
Actual banana fruit or identifiable banana pieces/peel belonging to the fruit. Exclude other elongated yellow foods or decorative/toy fruit.
Actual apple fruit or identifiable apple pieces. Exclude oranges, peaches, tomatoes and fruit whose apple identity is uncertain.
An actual sandwich or hamburger with filling supported by bread, including identifiable sandwich portions. Exclude hot dogs, pizza, plain bread, and bagels/doughnuts without sandwich filling.
Actual orange fruit or identifiable orange sections/peel. Exclude lemons, other citrus whose orange identity is uncertain, tomatoes and orange-colored objects.
Actual broccoli florets/stalks or identifiable broccoli portions. Exclude cauliflower, lettuce, generic greens and green sauces unless broccoli is identifiable.
Actual carrots or identifiable carrot pieces. Exclude orange peppers, other orange foods and uncertain vegetable fragments.
An identifiable hot-dog/frankfurter food item, with or without a bun. Exclude generic sausages if frankfurter identity is uncertain, hamburgers and other sandwiches.
An actual pizza or identifiable pizza slice/portion with pizza crust and topping context. Exclude sandwiches, unrelated flatbreads and cake.
An actual doughnut/donut, including ring or filled varieties and identifiable portions. Exclude plain bagels, onion rings, lifebuoys and uncertain ring-shaped baked foods.
Actual cake, including slices, cupcakes and cheesecake. Exclude doughnuts, bread, pies, pancakes and unrelated desserts unless cake is identifiable.
An actual single-person chair, including office/barber/dining chairs and identifiable chair parts. Exclude benches, couches, beds and toy furniture.
An actual sofa/couch or identifiable upholstered sofa seat/back. Exclude individual armchairs, benches and beds.
An actual plant growing in an identifiable pot/container, with plant-and-pot context. Exclude cut flowers in vases, unpotted trees/shrubs and ambiguous greenery without pot evidence.
An actual bed or identifiable bed frame/mattress/bedding in bed context. Exclude sofas, chairs and loose cloth whose bed context is uncertain.
An actual table identifiable as a dining/eating table, including its tabletop or legs in dining-table context. Exclude computer/work desks, counters, floors and ambiguous table/counter surfaces.
An actual toilet fixture or identifiable toilet bowl, seat or cistern. Exclude sinks, baths, generic basins and toilet-paper/tissue boxes alone.

An actual standalone television/monitor display, including desktop monitors and TV-type displays on exercise equipment. Exclude laptop-integrated screens, cell phones, projected/printed pictures and the objects depicted inside a screen.
An actual laptop/notebook computer or identifiable integrated laptop screen/keyboard/base. Exclude standalone monitors, desktop keyboards, tablets and cell phones.
An actual computer mouse/input device or identifiable mouse body. Exclude the animal, remotes and unidentified small desktop objects.
An actual handheld electronic remote-control unit identified by its body/button layout or clear use context. Exclude phones, keyboards, unidentifiable key fobs and generic rectangular objects.
An actual computer keyboard or identifiable keyboard keys/body, including integrated laptop keyboards. Exclude musical keyboards, remote controls and printed keyboard images.
An actual mobile/cell phone, including identifiable handset portions. Exclude remote controls, cameras, tablets and generic small rectangles.
An actual microwave oven or identifiable microwave door/control panel in microwave context. Exclude conventional ovens, cooker hoods, refrigerators and televisions.

An actual conventional cooking oven, including identifiable oven door/cavity or range with oven. Exclude microwave ovens, cooker hoods, stovetops alone without identifiable oven context and generic cabinets.
An actual sink/washbasin or identifiable sink bowl/tap assembly in sink context. Exclude toilets, bathtubs, portable bowls and isolated taps whose sink context is uncertain.
An actual refrigerator/freezer appliance or identifiable refrigerator door/body. Exclude ordinary cabinets, ovens, microwaves and generic metal panels.
An actual bound book or identifiable book cover/pages/spine. Exclude magazines/newspapers, isolated sheets, framed prints and illegible rectangular objects.
An actual clock/time-of-day clock object or identifiable clock face/body. Exclude exercise timers, parking-meter dials, incidental digital time on phones/computers and generic circular dials.
An actual vase or identifiable vase body holding or intended to hold flowers. Exclude plant pots, bottles, drinking vessels and generic containers without vase identity.
Actual scissors or identifiable paired cutting blades/handle loops. Exclude single knives, forceps and unrelated metal strips.
An actual bear-shaped plush/stuffed toy, including identifiable teddy-bear parts. Exclude real bears, humans in bear costumes and non-bear plush toys.
An actual toothbrush identified by its narrow handle and bristled head, including electric toothbrushes. Exclude hairbrushes, paintbrushes, remotes and unidentified thin handles.

scope_notes: TV deliberately includes standalone computer monitors; integrated laptop screens count as laptop, and a laptop keyboard may also count as keyboard.
Donut excludes plain bagels; hot dog uses identifiable frankfurter rather than generic sausage; dining table excludes identifiable work desks/counters.
Category names/order derive only from verified native targets; training category assignments are not visual labels.

Cup includes recognizable handleless drinking tumblers and pint glasses; material and the presence of a handle alone do not exclude a drinking cup. Wine-glass-form stemmed vessels retain their separate definition.
These are explicit study review definitions based on native target names; no assertion that every border case reproduces an external dataset annotation policy.

instruction: Judge each crop against EVERY fixed category definition. No response overlays or method identities. Explicit yes/no/unclear for all75; missing image stays missing, never absent.
